# Synthetic documented Worker responses

These fixtures model current official response schemas; they are not provider receipts or interoperability proof. Identifiers, clocks, authors and module content are synthetic. No legacy `deployment_id` is supplied. Regenerate with `node tests/fixtures/checklist-worker-wire/generate.mjs`.

Sources checked 2026-10-13:

`settings.json` is separately hand-authored, not generated from the upload metadata or by the generator above. It models [Script and Version Settings GET](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/workers/subresources/scripts/subresources/script_and_version_settings/methods/get/), the actual `/workers/scripts/{name}/settings` endpoint. Do not confuse it with [Script Settings GET](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/workers/subresources/scripts/subresources/settings/methods/get/), which uses `/script-settings`. The pinned [official 5.2.0 client](https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-typescript/blob/6dbe1fc45b41f102e5edcd3630d6fd3e803552ce/src/resources/workers/scripts/script-and-version-settings.ts) also declares `/settings`, runtime configuration, `observability.enabled`, optional sampling and nested logs; current documentation additionally declares traces, issues and other optional fields. Sampling defaults to 1. Trace propagation policy may be null when unavailable. These documented additions make whole-object equality against a partial observability request inappropriate; no claim is made that the provider always returns these defaults.

The settings tests independently pin synthetic source/target values. Bootstrap's synthetic provider combines this fixture's Worker settings with its captured version upload configuration, rather than echoing `checklistUploadMetadata`. Required top-level observability and nested traces enable flags must both be explicit true booleans. Missing/null/array containers, wrongly nested flags, false/string/numeric flags and changed or malformed bindings/runtime/limits/Logpush/usage values refuse. Extra unrequested observability fields are outside the existing required-flag projection; accepting them does not approve changes to a requested flag.

The version-create and settings GET contracts both enumerate `usage_model` as `standard`, `bundled` or `unbound`. Creation marks the optional top-level JSON field deprecated; neither API documents normalization to a different enum. Settings diagnostic version 2 records only these exact public enum strings and redacts unknown strings/non-string shapes. Settings tests still reject every non-Standard value. Version tests exercise both actual builders through the preflight/dispatch serializer, verify top-level Standard and unchanged CPU/subrequest limits, and reject omitted, nested, malformed and non-Standard requested models. Bootstrap tests independently assert the actual POST bytes and requested-model/body-hash journal fields, rather than relying only on equality with the builder.

- [Worker Version create](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/workers/subresources/beta/subresources/workers/subresources/versions/methods/create/): required `id`, `created_on`, `number`, `urls`; optional configuration and modules. `deploy=true` creates a deployment with this version at 100%.
- [Worker Version get](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/workers/subresources/beta/subresources/workers/subresources/versions/methods/get/): `include=modules` requests exact base64 module content.
- [Deployment list](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/workers/subresources/scripts/subresources/deployments/methods/list/): result object contains `deployments`; the first returned deployment is active. Each has separate deployment `id`, creation clock, source, strategy and version percentages. `deployments-active-head.json` gives a later historical entry a newer clock to ensure it cannot replace the active head; equal clocks are also tested.
- [Script PUT](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/workers/subresources/scripts/methods/update/): required startup time; `id` means script name and does not supply a version identity.
- [Immutable official client](https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-typescript/tree/6dbe1fc45b41f102e5edcd3630d6fd3e803552ce/src/resources/workers): `beta/workers/versions.ts`, `scripts/scripts.ts`, `scripts/deployments.ts`.

Optional defaults are deliberately included to exercise documented extensions. Tests parameterize the reviewed binding/module values and reject missing required data, substitutions between identity domains, wrong bytes/configuration, public URLs and pagination. A schema fixture never proves hosted runtime success or authorizes a provider operation.
